'''July''' is the seventh month in the [[Wikipedia:Gregorian calendar|Gregorian calendar]]. It occurs in Wheel of Time world during [[Amadaine]] [[Amadaine 23|23]] to [[Tammaz]] [[Tammaz 25|25]].
